stem: A 7-year-old with cystic fibrosis attends routine follow-up, and the family asks which nutrient group needs ongoing review as part of care. Which is most appropriate?
explanation: Fat-soluble vitamins are the correct answer. Ongoing cystic fibrosis care includes review of fat-soluble vitamin needs.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because cystic fibrosis care includes monitoring and supporting fat-soluble vitamin needs.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because vitamin C alone is not the nutrient group specifically supported in cystic fibrosis care.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because the key issue is fat-soluble vitamin review, not water-soluble vitamins only.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because iron alone is not the nutrient group identified for ongoing cystic fibrosis care.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because vitamin considerations do apply, specifically fat-soluble vitamins.
